Pen use

Wegovy injection sites and pen use

Wegovy is injected under the skin of the stomach area, thigh or upper arm once a week, at a new spot each time.1 It needs no mixing or reconstitution: the injection comes ready to use in single-dose pens, prefilled syringes or a FlexTouch pen.1 The tablets are swallowed whole each morning.1

Nothing to mix

Every Wegovy injection holds a clear, colorless solution with a pH of about 7.4, ready to use as supplied.1 In single-dose pens and syringes the inactive ingredients are disodium phosphate dihydrate, sodium chloride and water for injection; the FlexTouch solution has disodium phosphate dihydrate, phenol, propylene glycol and water for injection.1 On single-dose pens the dose is already set and the needle is hidden inside the needle cover, so there is nothing to draw up or measure.1

Presentations

Presentation What it holds1 Doses per unit1
Single-dose pen 0.25 mg/0.5 mL, 0.5 mg/0.5 mL, 1 mg/0.5 mL, 1.7 mg/0.75 mL, 2.4 mg/0.75 mL or 7.2 mg/0.75 mL (Wegovy HD); 4 pens per carton One
Prefilled syringe 0.25 mg, 0.5 mg, 1 mg, 1.7 mg or 2.4 mg, with an integrated needle; 4 per carton One
FlexTouch pen 9.6 mg in 3 mL (3.2 mg/mL), dialed to 2.4 mg only; NovoFine Plus 32G 4 mm needles included Four weekly doses
Tablets 1.5 mg, 4 mg, 9 mg or 25 mg; bottle of 30 One a day

Choosing a Wegovy injection site

The label names three areas: the stomach area (abdomen), the thigh and the upper arm.1 Similar drug levels are reached from all three, and the injection goes under the skin, never into a muscle or vein.1 For each Wegovy injection site, the pen instructions say to avoid skin that is tender, bruised, red or hard, or that has scars or stretch marks.1 In the lower stomach, they say to stay at least 2 inches from the belly button.1 With the prefilled syringe, the back of the upper arm should only be used with help from someone else.1

Rotating sites

The site changes with every dose: the same body area may be used each week, but not the same spot.1 General patient guides suggest spacing injections at least 1 inch apart and keeping a chart of spots already used.56 The NHS adds that people who also inject insulin should inject semaglutide in a different place from the insulin.7

Using each presentation

Single-dose pen

The pen is pressed firmly against the skin.1 Two clicks are heard, and the injection takes about 5 to 10 seconds.1 The pen stays pressed until the yellow bar in the window stops moving, which the instructions use to confirm the full dose was given.1

Prefilled syringe

A fold of skin is pinched, the needle goes fully in at a 45-degree angle, and the plunger is pushed all the way down.1

FlexTouch pen

Only 2.4 mg doses can be dialed, and one pen gives 4 doses.1 A new needle is attached for every injection, and the flow is checked before the first dose from each new pen.1 Sharing a FlexTouch pen is ruled out even when the needle is changed, since it can spread blood-borne infections.1 The label does not recommend it for self-injection by people with visual impairment.1

Before each injection

A healthcare provider trains the patient on the specific presentation before first use, and again if the prescribed presentation changes.1 The solution is checked each time and used only if it is clear, colorless and free of particles.1 General patient guides also advise washing hands with soap and running water and checking the label for the right medicine and dose.5

Taking the tablets

Wegovy tablets are not injected. One tablet is taken in the morning on an empty stomach, with up to 4 ounces of plain water.1 It is swallowed whole, not split, crushed or chewed, and food, drinks and other oral medicines then wait at least 30 minutes.1 The tablets are white to light yellow and debossed with the strength and "novo".1

Storage

  • Single-dose pens and syringes. These are kept in the refrigerator at 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F), in the original carton to protect them from light.1 They are not frozen or stored next to the refrigerator's cooling element.1
  • When to discard them. A pen or syringe is thrown away if it has frozen or been exposed to light or to temperatures above 86°F (30°C).1 The same applies after 28 days or longer out of the refrigerator.1
  • FlexTouch. It is refrigerated before first use, then kept for up to 56 days at 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F) or in the refrigerator.1 It is stored with the cap on and no needle attached.1
  • Tablets. They are kept at room temperature, 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F), in the original closed bottle in a dry place, which protects them from moisture.1

Disposal

Used pens and syringes go into an FDA-cleared sharps disposal container right away.1 If no cleared container is at hand, FDA says a heavy-duty plastic household container, such as a laundry detergent bottle, can be used.23 It must be leak-resistant, stay upright and have a tight, puncture-resistant lid.23 FDA says loose needles never go into household or public trash, recycling bins or the toilet.28 Sharps containers are not reused, and they are kept out of reach of children and pets.4

Frequently asked questions

How do you administer Wegovy?

Wegovy injection is given under the skin once a week, on the same day each week, at any time of day, with or without meals.1 With a single-dose pen, the pen is pressed firmly against the skin until two clicks sound and the yellow bar stops moving, which takes about 5 to 10 seconds.1 Wegovy tablets are swallowed whole each morning with up to 4 ounces of water.1 A healthcare provider trains each patient on the prescribed form before the first dose.1

Where do you inject Wegovy?

Under the skin of the stomach area, the thigh or the upper arm, never into a muscle or vein.1 In the stomach area, the pen instructions say to stay at least 2 inches from the belly button.1 The label reports similar drug levels from all three areas.1 The spot changes every week, although the same body area can be used again, and skin that is tender, bruised, red, hard, scarred or stretch-marked is avoided.1

How long can a Wegovy pen stay out of the fridge?

When needed, single-dose pens and syringes can be kept at 8°C to 30°C (46°F to 86°F) for up to 28 days, before the cap is removed.1 They are thrown away after 28 days or more out of the refrigerator, or after exposure to temperatures above 86°F (30°C).1 The FlexTouch pen follows a different rule: after first use it keeps for up to 56 days at 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F) or in the refrigerator.1

How should used Wegovy pens be thrown away?

The label says used pens and syringes go straight into an FDA-cleared sharps disposal container, not household trash.1 FDA says these containers are rigid plastic with a fill line, and are available from pharmacies, medical supply companies, health care providers and online.23 When a container is about three-quarters full, local rules apply: FDA lists drop-off sites, household hazardous waste sites, mail-back programs and residential pick-up as options.4
